title: Inferring continuous cognitive traits from limited neuroimaging data using pairwise convolutional neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.27668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Individual differences in cognitive abilities vary widely, yet the structural brain features supporting these differences remain poorly understood. Traditional brain-behavior analyses rely on predefined metrics such as volume or cortical thickness and typically assume linear relationships with behavior, limiting sensitivity in small datasets. Here, we introduce a pairwise convolutional ranking framework that learns directly from whole-brain T1-weighted MRI by making comparative rather than absolute predictions, which performs well even with small samples (N=108). We tested this method with four small-scale spatial abilities tasks. Regression analysis predicted performance with high accuracy across all tasks, achieving greater predictive power over standard regression and pointwise deep learning baselines. translated_title: 利用成对卷积神经网络从有限神经影像数据中推断连续认知特征
translated_abstract: 认知能力的个体差异广泛存在，然而支持这些差异的大脑结构特征仍知之甚少。传统的脑-行为分析依赖于预定义的指标（如体积或皮层厚度），并且通常假设其与行为呈线性关系，这限制了在小数据集上的敏感性。在这里，我们提出了一种成对卷积排序框架，该框架直接从全脑T1加权MRI中学习，通过进行比较性预测而非绝对预测，即使在小样本（N=108）条件下也能表现良好。我们使用四个小尺度空间能力任务对该方法进行了测试。回归分析在所有任务中均以较高的准确率预测了任务表现，其预测能力超过了标准回归和逐点深度学习基线方法。通过迭代的皮层区域去除（后向消除法），我们揭示了支持所有四个任务中个体表现共同依赖的大脑区域。
tldr: 提出了一种成对卷积排序框架，通过比较式学习直接从全脑MRI推断连续认知特征，即使在小样本（N=108）条件下也能准确预测空间能力表现，并优于传统回归和逐点深度学习方法。
en_tdlr: A pairwise convolutional ranking framework that learns directly from whole-brain T1-weighted MRI via comparative rather than absolute predictions accurately infers continuous cognitive traits even from small samples (N=108), outperforming standard regression and pointwise deep learning baselines.
